notes.title: Thief Arrives! & 100 Steam Key Giveaway!
notes.content:
The Brand-New EN Localization for Next Fest is Now Live!!!


Greetings, Card Fiends!

After a week of non-stop grinding, we’ve not only squashed a mountain of bugs (and probably created a small hill of new ones), but we've also packed Apokerlypse with a ton of new features based on your feedback! (Check out our last announcement, Dev Log #02, for all the deets).

But most importantly, a new, rule-breaking friend has crashed the party today—Thief!


Meet Character #4: Thief! 🗡️
This sly character specializes in creating "surprises" at the card table.

His core mechanic, \[Combo], lets him play multiple hands in a row!

With the right build, he can string together a dozen moves, leaving your opponent wondering what just hit them...

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45595611/2c1368fbaf0f90cc8a08859326c832f0b33f0485.png"]

One moment your opponent is pondering their life choices, the next they're facing a hurricane of cards!

And what's an update without some goodies?

For Steam Next Fest, we've prepared an awesome event packed with rewards!


Giveaway: 100 Keys Up For Grabs!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45595611/0f87bafda5f703a6b9770040ddc0a717d668d7d5.png"]

PS：Sorry about the ongoing EN UI adjustments! But this EN translation is a brand-new version, polished specifically for Steam Next Fest. We hope it provides a much smoother gameplay experience!

Details are in the graphic above! All you have to do is reach the Platinum rank with any character (it's super easy, we promise!).

Then, head to the giveaway page from the bottom-right of the main menu, enter your email, and you're in the draw for our 100-Key prize pool!





🙏🙏🙏 And finally, we can't stress this enough:

If you're enjoying the game, please, please, PLEASE:
ADD APOKERLYPSE TO YOUR STEAM WISHLIST!
It is absolutely crucial for a small studio like ours and means the world to us. Thank you for all your support!



Alright, we're off to fix (and create) more bugs!

See you at the tables, friends!



- The Entire Breaker Games Team

notes.title: Dev Log #02: Balance Adjustments & All Characters Gameplay Expansion
notes.content:
New Features
New Shuffle Mechanic (to reduce the impact of luck)

10 New Chips for the Dragon Queen (enabling her to command 3 dragons, gain immunity to Freeze, etc.)

9 New Chips for the Pyromancer (including a self-destruct build, strategic card burning, and chips to strengthen his mid-game transition)

Pyromancer's Exclusive Trait has been changed to \[Ignite] (When ignited, it generates an additional Ash)

6 New Chips for the Priestess (including 2 powerful Legendary chips)

All-New Betting System

2x Speed Mode

New spell card VFX and pack-opening animations

A new batch of Steam Achievements


Bug Fixes & Optimizations
Optimized matchmaking algorithm

Fatigue Mechanic Reworked: Fatigue is now tracked individually for each player

Fireball can no longer be Frozen

Fixed an issue causing the ""Wangdoyu"" chip to malfunction

Fixed a bug that caused players to lose chips after disconnecting and rejoining

Various other bug fixes

Adjusted the stats on several chips for better balance

notes.title: Online VS Confirmed Early!
notes.content:
We've received some feedback from our English-speaking players that the current English localization isn't up to par. We apologize! We're already working on a new, higher-quality localization and will get an improved version to you all ASAP in just a few days. Thanks for your continued interest in our game!

Hey everyone!

It's only been 4 days since the free demo for 'Apokerlypse' went live,
and we've already seen a huge influx of new faces in our social media communities (in case you didn't already know, click here to go to our Discord)!

Thank you all for your love and support! We've received tons of your feedback and suggestions, and we're continuously working on improvements and optimizations!
(We even spent the entire Dragon Boat Festival working overtime to squash bugs!)


And now for the big news! 
We've heard your loudest demand loud and clear—You want to duke it out with your buddies in online PVP battles!
This was originally a reward for hitting the [50,000 Wishlist Milestone], but as a thank you for your incredible support, we're announcing it early:
'Apokerlypse' will feature an [Online VS] mode in the full release!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45595611/57079dc5951ecedb4ac551d6005859adb3f56b75.png

Soon, you'll be able to create private rooms for custom matches with your friends—see who gets demolished with their 17 cards, and who's going to be eating their monitor!


If you think our game is pretty cool,
Please consider adding it to your Steam Wishlist to support us!
This means the world to a small studio like ours, especially with many more wishlist rewards waiting for you to unlock!

The demo is still live! Join us now,
and become one of our OG players!


Have fun playing,
I'm off to squash more bugs!

Wilson, Game Producer

notes.title: Dev Log #01: Score Survival Mode & Fatigue Mechanic Archetypes
notes.content:
May Update Notes:  
1. Introduced Fatigue Mechanic and Fatigue/Control archetypes (primarily to enhance counterplay against OTK archetypes)  
2. Refined the Score Survival Mode and improved its UI presentation  
3. Added in-match Skill Rating system  
4. Upgraded "Attached Card" system to "Enchantment" system (all enchanted cards are guaranteed to be drawn for deck consistency)  
5. New spell card added: Dimensional Foil  
6. Implemented streamlined New Player Tutorial  
7. Added Quick Settings functionality  
8. Initial balance pass for Characters/Chips/Merchandise/Cocktails (ongoing adjustments based on telemetry data next week)  
9. Card visual overhaul in progress (current effects may look a bit janky)
10. Optimized AI algorithm performance  
11. Completed primary chip set visual designs  
12. Squashed a ton of bugs  

Next two weeks' development focus:  
• Chip expansion for 4 core characters  
• Ongoing balance tuning  

P.S. Two new characters are currently in full production - stay tuned for reveals!

notes.title: Reveal Playtest LIVE! 1000 Limited Global Spots!
notes.content:
Oi~ Friends! The wait is over!

We're Breaker Games, a dev team passionate about crafting fun and quirky Roguelike experiences.

Today, kicking things off during the Eastern Game Fest, we're thrilled to unveil our brand-new creation to all of you – 
Apokerlypse!

So, what kind of game is it?
Simply put, it's:
   ✧ Inspired by classic poker games
   ✧ + Packed with Roguelike elements (Hero abilities, game-rule-bending Demon Chips, Spell Cards, Deckbuilding, and more!).
   ✧ + Async PvP (You'll face off against deck data meticulously built by players from all around the world).

Basically, the way you play cards here is wildly unconventional. You can make your "Straights" infinitely long, or even summon a dragon to incinerate all cards in hand...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45595611/e59f182c7e225f57c1ba883d37ad0a71d5333235.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45595611/0148122bdc3e614b7a39b0ae5a46eaa60419edf9.png

Apokerlypse First Global Playtest is HERE!

We can't wait! To get this mind-bending yet easy-to-pick-up battle game into your hands as soon as possible, and to ensure the game continuously benefits from your invaluable supervision and feedback, we've decided after careful consideration to run this playtest (think of it as a party!) using a special event format!

The event will be held in two stages:

✧ Phase 1 (Starts Now! Duration: Approx. 3 days, subject to adjustment based on playtest progress)
To ensure the highest game quality and prepare the best possible version for all our future players who love our game,
we are recruiting **over 200 Pioneer Players** for this initial phase!

 How to Join: Hurry and join our official Discord server! Send a direct message (DM) to an admin for one-on-one early Key activation and test access!
 Your Crucial Mission: You will help us observe the game's performance in a real matchmaking environment, identify potential issues early on, and collaborate with us to refine the game!
 Feedback Loop: The development team will be on standby during the May Day holiday period to quickly implement optimizations and bug fixes based on your feedback, and even consider incorporating your game-changing suggestions!

✧ Phase 2: Open Global Test - 1000 Slots! (Starts after Phase 1 concludes)

 How to Join: Click the "Request Access" button on our Steam store page to apply. Access will be granted progressively on a first-come, first-served basis!
 Test Goal: Don't be shy! Team up with your friends, chat with the developers, and give us your brutally honest feedback on every aspect of the game. This allows us to be more open and divergent in optimizing the final version!
 Feedback Method: https://wj.qq.com/s2/21401251/ga95/

Also, VERY important, we gotta say it 3 times!
Please Wishlist the game! Wishlist it! Wishlist it! Please, it's incredibly important to us!
Not only is it the biggest encouragement you can give us, but it also helps unlock more future game content! Check out our Wishlist Goals (You know you want 'em!):

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45595611/7ffd3ccc721a94fdac0e92611b977467bd67259e.png

Lastly, if you want to stay updated on our future developments and news:

 Join our Discord Community: https://discord.gg/KBPyuZf44q
 Follow our Official X/Twitter Account (for the latest ongoing updates): 

 X: https://x.com/Project_zero2
 Youtube: https://www.youtube.com/@breakergames

OK, that's the spiel! We're really looking forward to getting schooled by all your crazy strategies at the card table (or maybe turning the tables on you)!

Let's deal!
Let's see who will 
rise to the top and become the ultimate card shark!


Cheers,
The Entire Breaker Games Team
